ids.description: Set of ids to be invalidated.

contexts.description: Set of contexts for this invalidation. Context type depends on the invalidation queue.

priority.description: Priority for invalidation queue entries.  If not specified, the default priority for the queue will be used.

nodePool.description:
When non-null, the invalidation queue entries will only be processed by servers with a matching nodePool.
When null, the entries will only be processed by servers from default nodePool.

propagateActionContext.description: If set to true, {@link Action.Context} will be propagated to invalidation queue entries.

disabled.description:
If true, and invalidation is being done with autoCommit, then the state of the entries will be set to "disabled"
rather than "pending".

title:
C3 type for arguments for InvalidationQueue functions.

in the most generic sense all contexts apply to all ids

however in real use cases there is either 1 id and a set of contexts or set of ids and a single context
name: InvalidationSpec
